"""Verify source/cache/export/prediction/native pixels and rounded report cells."""
import hashlib
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from PIL import Image
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1'
output=repo/'docs/results/v160-paired-response-publication-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
index=repo/'docs/results/v160-paired-response-final-v1.json';publication=read(index)
prep=read(publication['preparation']['path']);assert len(prep['copies'])==19
for item in list(prep['copies'].values())+list(publication['copies'].values()):
    assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original'] and ref(item['public']['path'])==item['public']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
for version in [1,2]:guard(read(root/f'plan-v{version}.json'))
guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json'))
bundle=read(prep['sources']['path']);assert len(bundle['source_texts'])==78
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
assert len(bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'])==87
for path,h in bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(path)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(path).name)['sha256']==h
more=read(publication['source_bundle']['path'])
for item in more['additional_sources']+[more['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']

def fingerprint(value):
    a=np.ascontiguousarray(value)
    return {'shape':list(a.shape),'dtype':a.dtype.str,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest()}

cache=read(root/'cache-result-v2.json');assert len(cache['batches'])==1000
cache_fields=0
for row in cache['batches']:
    assert ref(row['arrays']['path'])==row['arrays'] and ref(row['parent']['path'])==row['parent']
    a=dict(np.load(row['arrays']['path']));base=np.load(row['parent']['path'])
    assert {k:fingerprint(v) for k,v in a.items()}==row['inputs']
    assert fingerprint(base)==row['parent_values'] and np.isfinite(base).all()
    cache_fields+=len(a)+1
training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');assert ref(training['checkpoint']['path'])==training['checkpoint']
state=torch.load(training['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
assert state['step']==state['horizon']==1000 and all(float(s['step'])==1000 for arm in state['optimizers'].values() for s in arm['state'].values())
assert all(torch.isfinite(t).all() for arm in state['optimizers'].values() for s in arm['state'].values() for t in s.values())
assert sum(len(arm['state']) for arm in state['optimizers'].values())==90
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')
cases={c['id']:c for c in design['observations']};assert len(cases)==822
maps={};prediction_paths=set();forward_inputs=ADC_constants=0
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    c=read(binding['path']);assert c['module_before']==c['module_after'] and c['component_forwards']==822
    assert c['RNG_unchanged'] and not c['adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay']
    assert ref(c['export']['path'])==c['export']
    export=torch.load(c['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    key='models' if c['endpoint']=='raw' else 'emas'
    assert len(export['state_dict'])==45 and export['parent']==state['parent']
    assert all(torch.equal(v,state[key][c['arm']][n]) for n,v in export['state_dict'].items())
    maps[label]={r['id']:r['prediction'] for r in c['observations']}
    for row,case in zip(c['observations'],design['observations'],strict=True):
        assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent'] and row['module_forwards']==1
        assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction']
        assert Path(row['prediction']['path']).is_relative_to('/mnt/external')
        assert row['prediction']['path'] not in prediction_paths;prediction_paths.add(row['prediction']['path'])
        a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));value=np.load(row['prediction']['path'])
        assert fingerprint(value)==row['values'] and value.dtype==np.float32 and np.isfinite(value).all()
        for field,f in row['inputs'].items():assert fingerprint(a[field])==f;forward_inputs+=1
        if case['kind']=='flat' and case['noise']['name']=='adc-only' and case.get('cohort')!='adc-sloped512':
            assert np.array_equal(value,np.load(case['parent']['path']));ADC_constants+=1
assert len(prediction_paths)==3288 and forward_inputs==13152 and ADC_constants==192
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json');public=read(publication['figures']['path'])
assert len(public['images'])==len(figures['images'])==72
retained={}
for label,binding in figures['retained_collections'].items():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    c=read(binding['path']);retained[label]={r['id']:r['prediction'] for r in c['observations']}
    for case,row in zip(design['observations'],c['observations'],strict=True):
        assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent']
aliases={'Ordinary raw1k':'ordinary-raw-step1000','Ordinary EMA1k':'ordinary-EMA-step1000',
    'Pair response raw1k':'paired-response-raw-step1000','Pair response EMA1k':'paired-response-EMA-step1000'}
channels=0
for original,item in zip(figures['images'],public['images'],strict=True):
    assert item['original_image']==original['image'] and ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image']
    assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(original['image']['path']).read_bytes()
    assert item['no_resize'] and item['ROI_xywh']==original['ROI_xywh']
    case=item['case'];a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));roi=item['ROI_xywh']
    image=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));anchor=np.array(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1)
    for panel in item['panels']:
        name=panel['label'];is_JPEG=False
        if name=='Noisy Malvar':value=noisy_malvar(a)
        elif name=='V143 parent':value=np.load(case['parent']['path'])
        elif name in aliases:value=np.load(maps[aliases[name]][case['id']]['path'])
        elif name in retained:
            binding=retained[name][case['id']];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;value=np.load(binding['path'])
        elif name=='Periodic detail':value=np.load(case['periodic_detail']['path'])
        elif name in ['Exact constructed GT','ISO100 AHD, not GT']:
            value=a['reference_rgb'] if 'reference_rgb' in a else np.load(case['reference_binding']['path']) if case['kind']=='real' else a['target']
        else:
            assert name in ['ISO6400 JPEG native','ISO100 JPEG, not GT']
            window=next(w for w in case['cases'] if w['ROI_xywh']==roi)
            key='noisy_camera_jpeg' if name.startswith('ISO6400') else 'reference_camera_jpeg'
            binding=window['camera_JPEGs'][key]['pixels'];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
            value=np.load(binding['path']);is_JPEG=True
        selected_roi=[0,0,160,160] if name=='ISO100 AHD, not GT' and value.shape[-2:]==(160,160) else roi
        expected=value if is_JPEG else independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,selected_roi,item['exposure'])
        x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160 and expected.shape==(160,160,3)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected);channels+=expected.size
assert channels==50764800
report=repo/'docs/paired-response.md';text=report.read_text();tables=read(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json')
scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in scores['summary']}
for cell in tables['cells']:
    row=summaries[cell['kind'],cell['condition'],cell['cohort'],cell['method']]
    assert cell['rendered']==f"{row[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}"
for line in tables['lines']:assert line in text,line
dc=read(root/'quiet-DC-audit-v1.json')
for item in dc['groups']:
    assert f"| {item['prior']} | {item['method']} | {item['mean_DC_RMS_DN16']:.6f} |" in text
paired=read(root/'paired-region-comparison-v1.json');rows={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in scores['rows']}
paired_entries=0
for group in paired['groups']:
    for pair in group['pairs']:
        assert pair['candidate']==rows[pair['id'],group['method']][group['field']]
        assert pair['baseline']==rows[pair['id'],group['baseline']][group['field']]
        assert pair['difference']==pair['candidate']-pair['baseline'];paired_entries+=1
execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');assert execution['recorded_owner_count']==15
assert execution['actual_sensor_sampler_API_calls']=={'Poisson':3312,'Gaussian':1928}
diary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();assert diary.is_relative_to(repo/'diary') and diary.is_file()
docs=[repo/p for p in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/paired-response.md']]+[diary]
links=0
for path in docs:
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        target=(path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert target==output or target.is_file(),(path,link)
        links+=1
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(output,{'status':'pass-full-cache-export-prediction-native-pixel-and-document-verification','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'publication':ref(index),'preparation_receipts':19,'final_receipts':len(publication['copies']),
    'preparation_source_texts':78,'unchanged_neural_sources':87,'final_helper_texts':len(more['additional_sources']),
    'cache_batches':1000,'cache_field_fingerprints':cache_fields,'new_prediction_arrays':3288,
    'review_input_fingerprints':forward_inputs,'ADC_constants_exact_parent':ADC_constants,
    'native_figures':72,'native_RGB_channels_recomputed':channels,'report_rounded_cells':len(tables['cells'])+len(dc['groups']),
    'paired_current_error_entries':paired_entries,'document_links_checked':links,
    'documents':{str(p):ref(p) for p in docs},'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'CUDA_initialized':False,
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print('PASS cache1000,3288 predictions,',channels,'native channels,215 report cells,',paired_entries,'paired errors and',links,'links')
